column3: The Hebrew says the feet were standing; BSB says they are standing.
The Hebrew says the tribes went up; BSB says they go up.
The Hebrew depicts the thrones as sitting; BSB says they stand.
The Hebrew asks that those loving Jerusalem be at ease; BSB says prosper.
The Hebrew has a singular rampart and names ease; BSB has walls and prosperity.
The Hebrew says good for you; BSB says your prosperity.
